metadata.description: MCP server for TherapyNotes client portals (TherapyPortal) — read appointments, paperwork, forms, balances, receipts and secure messages, and download completed documents and receipts. Signs in server-side with the portal password, or relays requests through the user's signed-in browser tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension.

plugins.name: therapyportal-mcp
plugins.description: Read a TherapyNotes client portal (TherapyPortal) — upcoming appointments, paperwork, practice forms, balances, receipts and secure messages, plus document and receipt downloads. Signs in server-side or relays through the user's signed-in browser tab.
